screens.name: Template Gallery
screens.purpose: Couple browses and selects an invitation template to start building.

screens.name: Invitation Editor
screens.purpose: Couple enters names, date, venue, photos, and greeting message onto the chosen template.

screens.name: Guest View Preview
screens.purpose: Couple previews exactly what guests will see before publishing.

screens.name: Publish and Share
screens.purpose: Confirms the invitation is live and lets the couple copy the shareable link.

screens.name: Guest Invitation Page
screens.purpose: Guest opens the shared link (no login) and reads greeting, date, venue with map, and transport/parking guidance.

screens.name: RSVP Form
screens.purpose: Guest submits attendance with headcount and meal preference; lightweight for low-end phones.

qualityChecks.expected: All 6 plan screens exist as routable sections
qualityChecks.observed: div ids screen-template-gallery/-invitation-editor/-guest-preview/-publish-share/-guest-invitation/-rsvp-form all present (lines 238-356); SCREENS array (line 390) lists all 6 ids and render() routes #screen-<id> hashes to them

qualityChecks.expected: Choose a template routes template-gallery -> invitation-editor
qualityChecks.observed: Three 'Use this template' buttons with onclick go('invitation-editor') (lines 246, 253, 260)

qualityChecks.expected: Preview the guest view routes invitation-editor -> guest-preview
qualityChecks.observed: CTA 'Preview the guest view' onclick go('guest-preview') (line 292)

qualityChecks.expected: Back to edit routes guest-preview -> invitation-editor
qualityChecks.observed: CTA 'Back to edit' onclick go('invitation-editor') (line 310); device-bar back button also targets data-back='invitation-editor'

qualityChecks.expected: Open shared link routes publish-share -> guest-invitation
qualityChecks.observed: Anchor 'Open guest page' href=#screen-guest-invitation (line 327); hashchange listener + render() activates that screen since 'guest-invitation' is in SCREENS

qualityChecks.expected: Submit RSVP returns to guest-invitation with confirmation
qualityChecks.observed: submitRsvp() (line 432) unhides #rsvp-confirm toast ('RSVP received. Thank you!', line 332) then go('guest-invitation')
grep for src=/https/url() found only url(#arrowhead) (local SVG fragment) and a display-only https URL as readonly input value (line 322); no img src, external scripts, fonts, or stylesheets

qualityChecks.expected: lang attribute set; each screen has an h1
qualityChecks.observed: html lang='en' (line 2); h1 in all 6 screens (lines 239, 266, 297, 316, 335, 357) - guest-invitation's h1 is the couple-names heading 'Jiyoon & Minho'

qualityChecks.expected: Every form input has an accessible label
qualityChecks.observed: label[for] pairs for ed-names, ed-date, ed-venue, ed-address, ed-greeting, share-link; all radios wrapped in <label class='radio-row'>; stepper buttons carry aria-label Decrease/Increase headcount and the output has aria-live inside a legend-ed fieldset

qualityChecks.expected: flow-build (choose template, enter details, photos+greeting, preview, publish+copy link) completable by clicking
qualityChecks.observed: Traced path: Flow map > Template Gallery > 'Use this template' > Invitation Editor (couple names, date, venue name/address inputs; two '+ Add photo' placeholders; greeting textarea) > 'Preview the guest view' > Guest View Preview > 'Publish' > Publish and Share showing live toast, share link field and working 'Copy link' button (flips to 'Copied!')

qualityChecks.expected: flow-guest (open link, read greeting/date/venue+map, transport/parking, RSVP with headcount+meal, transfer deep link) completable by clicking
qualityChecks.observed: Traced path: Publish and Share > 'Open guest page' > Guest Invitation Page (hero, names, date, greeting, Venue card with map placeholder, 'Getting there & parking' card with subway/parking placeholders) > 'RSVP' > RSVP Form (attend radios, 1-10 headcount stepper via step(), meal radios) > 'Submit RSVP' > returns to guest page with 'RSVP received' toast; 'Send congratulatory transfer' button present with 'Opens your banking app via deep link' note (static stub, appropriate for wireframe)

qualityChecks.expected: mustHaveScreens (Template gallery, Invitation editor, Guest invitation page, RSVP form) all represented
qualityChecks.observed: All four present as dedicated screens, plus guest-preview and publish-share covering the remaining flow-build steps; guest page notes 'No login needed to open it' matching the no-login constraint

qualityChecks.expected: Every PRD flow step represented in the wireframe
qualityChecks.observed: All 5 flow-build steps and all 5 flow-guest steps have concrete UI (template cards, detail inputs, photo/greeting fields, preview screen, share-link copy, greeting/date/venue+map, transport/parking card, RSVP form with headcount+meal, transfer deep-link button)

lang set, per-screen h1s, labeled inputs, aria-label on icon-only back/stepper buttons, role='status' on both confirmation toasts, aria-selected on view tabs, aria-hidden on the decorative flow-map SVG

qualityChecks.expected: Low-fi discipline: no brand styling leaked; legible hierarchy
qualityChecks.observed: Entirely grayscale (#f2f2f2/#fff/#444 etc.), hatched .ph placeholders for photos/map/greeting, system font stack, no brand colors or decorative fonts despite 'warm/celebratory' brandHints; hierarchy legible - numbered flow nodes with subtitles, h1 per screen, cards, solid primary vs dashed secondary CTAs

rationaleSummary: The six-screen inventory splits the PRD's two personas into a builder path (gallery > editor > preview > publish) and a guest path (invitation page > RSVP), with guest-preview and publish-share added beyond the four must-have screens so every flow-build step is clickable rather than implied. All screens live in one hash-routed HTML file with a flow-map landing view, keeping the prototype dependency-free and traceable edge-by-edge. Styling stays deliberately grayscale with hatched placeholders so review feedback targets structure and flow, not visual design.
